scope: Full Media compose-review C4; nine app ELFs and same Mongo no-DSO policy. No kernel changes. Shared libraries remain original in all new arms.
objective: Measure no-DSO ablation, actual live indirect targets and RPC-type/trace future code targets, with clean whole-stack endpoints.
training: Previously completed 2026-10-01 baseline PEBS/LBR; never request outcomes from current clean evaluation.
controls: Original, previously confirmed full DSO policy, no-DSO; incremental RPC NOP in independent confirmation as indicated by frozen protocol.
screen: Three exploratory paired blocks, randomized rotated orders, fresh stack per trial, 50s warmup +60s clean ROI; unprofiled E2E.
exclusions: Only objective operational validity gates, never unfavorable performance; no multiplicity-adjusted inference from exploratory screens.
runtime_invariant: Live immutable Processor iface; object and vtable loads are inspected and occur before arguments are read. No future handler execution or remote-address prefetch.
layout: Original instruction and return addresses preserved; runtime loads preserve r11 and flags; exact-length hint NOP controls.
environment: Shared host; controller84-85, load16-19, full stack32-39,2GHz restored per trial. Unrelated jobs untouched.
